rubrics.justification: The response overstates image-resolvable detail, especially a clearly visible compact ICM in the upper-left and a cohesive AA-quality TE; the image is somewhat indistinct and does not robustly support those specific claims, though the stated expansion/thinning zona is broadly compatible with the provided 3AA label.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, BMI, prior live births, endometrium, and sperm parameters into prognosis reasonably well, though some links are speculative or overstated.

The structure is logical and the probability estimate is internally organized, but several adjustments are somewhat arbitrary and some conclusions rely on weakly supported assumptions from the image and clinical data.

Much of the discussion is broadly IVF-consistent, but recommendations such as aspirin for PCOS perfusion optimization, ERA after a single failure, immunologic workup/NK cells, and routine progesterone targets are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
The response gives clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, but some suggested interventions are not well-evidenced or may be overly aggressive for this case.
